title: The Bramblecote Cider House
objective: Get back what you can of the Pell family's goods from the goblins in the cider house, and come out alive.

rooms.name: Lane Gate
rooms.description: A five-bar gate hangs open on the lane, and the air smells of windfall apples going soft in the grass. Beyond it a cobbled yard runs up to a long stone press house and a thatched farmhouse.

features.name: Bramblecote Sign
features.description: A painted board on the gatepost: a bramble, an apple and the word BRAMBLECOTE. Someone has daubed a crude goblin face over the apple.

features.name: Cart Ruts
features.description: Deep ruts in the lane mud, cut by a heavy cart.
features.discovery: Among the hoofprints are the prints of small bare feet, many of them, going in and out of the yard.

features.name: Orchard Hedge
features.description: A thick hawthorn hedge round the orchard, heavy with red berries and the last of the apples.

creatures.name: Widow Ressa Pell
creatures.description: A grey-haired woman in a cider-stained apron, leaning on a stick at the gate. She watches the yard with a hard, tired face.

topics.name: the goblins
topics.reply: "Four or five of them, maybe more. They came the night after the pressing and drove me and my lad out with knives. Their chief sleeps it off in the hayloft. You can hear him snore from the press house. Don't go up that ladder lightly: Snagtooth is quick with his blade, and Wick never leaves his side. Two blades against one is how my lad got cut."

topics.name: the strongroom
topics.reply: "Our savings are in the strongroom under the cask gallery. Snagtooth's runt, Wick, took the key off my belt. He keeps it on a string round his neck."

topics.name: the old well
topics.reply: "The old well drops straight into the vaults. My husband's father used it to lower casks. There's rope in the cooper's shed, if the goblins haven't burned it."

topics.name: Brack
topics.reply: "Brack was a good dog. They've chained him in the dog yard and starved him mean. He'll go for anyone now."

topics.name: the sump
topics.reply: "Nobody goes in the low cellar. It floods when the river's high, and things wash in. Leave it be."

rooms.name: Dog Yard
rooms.description: A muddy yard behind the farmhouse, ringed with gnawed bones and stinking of dog. A long chain runs from a post to a kennel of broken boards.

features.name: Kennel
features.description: A kennel of rotten boards, its straw trodden flat.
features.discovery: A gnawed goblin sandal lies in the straw. Brack has been eating better than his masters think.

features.name: Water Trough
features.description: A stone trough, its water green and scummed over.

features.name: Chain Post
features.description: An oak post with an iron ring. The chain is long enough to reach every corner of the yard.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.description: The farmhouse kitchen is cold, and it smells of burned stew and spilled cider. Chairs lie overturned around a scrubbed table.

features.name: Pantry
features.description: A narrow pantry, its shelves picked bare.
features.discovery: Behind a crock of pickled onions, where the goblins didn't look, stands a stoppered vial of red liquid.

features.name: Hearth
features.description: A wide hearth with a pot hanging over dead ashes. The goblins' stew has gone cold and grey.

features.name: Dresser
features.description: A tall dresser of blue plates, half of them smashed on the flagstones.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

rooms.name: Parlour
rooms.description: A small, quiet room with the shutters barred from inside. Dust lies thick on the good chairs; the goblins never came in here.

features.name: Barred Shutters
features.description: Oak shutters with a bar across them. Nothing can come in this way.

features.name: Settle
features.description: A high-backed settle with a patched cushion, long enough to sleep on.

features.name: Long-Case Clock
features.description: A tall clock painted with apple blossom, its pendulum still.
features.discovery: It stopped at a quarter past two: the hour the goblins came, and nobody has wound it since.

rooms.name: Cooper's Shed
rooms.description: Shavings carpet the floor of a lean-to shed, and it smells of oak and old smoke. Hoops and staves are stacked against every wall.

features.name: Tool Rack
features.description: A rack of adzes, drawknives and mallets.
features.discovery: A coil of good hemp rope hangs on the end peg, under a sack.

features.name: Stave Pile
features.description: Split oak staves, stacked to season. Some have been pulled out and burned.

features.name: Half-made Cask
features.description: A cask with half its staves in the hoop, left where the cooper dropped his tools.

items.name: Coil of Rope
items.description: Fifty feet of good hemp rope, dry and strong.

rooms.name: Press House
rooms.description: The long press house reeks of fermenting mash, and wasps drone over a heap of brown pulp. A great wooden press stands in the middle, and a trapdoor lies open in the floor. A ladder climbs to the hayloft.

features.name: Pomace Heap
features.description: A heap of pressed apple pulp, crawling with wasps. Something glints in it.
features.discovery: Nib has buried his hoard in the mash: a sticky handful of coins.

features.name: Cider Press
features.description: An oak press with a screw as thick as your leg. Something is wedged in its threads.
features.discovery: Jammed in the screw is a strip of bark scratched with a goblin tally: rows of barrels, each crossed out beside a little drawing of a boat. "To the river man," someone has scrawled. At the bottom, one last barrel isn't crossed out. Beside it are a grinning goblin face and a bag of coins, drawn next to one of the great casks in the vaults. Every other barrel is marked with a V inside a ring, but that cask's V has no ring. The goblins have hidden their share of the money in the cask with the bare V.

failure-by-5.text: You get a hand stuck in the sticky screw and pull it free with nothing to show but wasp stings.

failure.text: Whatever is in there is jammed too deep to see.

success.text: You work the bark free of the screw.

success-by-5.text: You work the bark free of the screw. A chalk arrow on the press frame points at the hatch, and beside it a goblin has scratched a circle and a line going down: the old well goes into the vaults too.

features.name: Trapdoor
features.description: A wide trapdoor, propped open, with a barrel ramp running down into the dark. Cold air comes up it.

items.name: Nib's Hoard
items.description: A sticky handful of gold coins.

items.name: Nib's Coins
items.description: A greasy pouch of copper pieces.

rooms.name: Hayloft
rooms.description: Loud snoring fills a dusty loft under the thatch, and the hay smells of mice and stale cider. Empty jugs roll on the boards.

features.name: Snagtooth's Sack
features.description: A greasy sack that the goblin chief uses as a pillow.
features.discovery: Inside, among apple cores and a broken pipe, are a few gold coins and a dark green stone flecked with red.

features.name: Hay Bales
features.description: Bales of last summer's hay, pulled apart into goblin nests.

features.name: Loft Door
features.description: A hay door open to the orchard, two storeys up. It's a long drop.

items.name: Bloodstone
items.description: A dark green stone flecked with red, polished smooth.

items.name: Strongroom Key
items.description: An iron key on a dirty string.

items.name: Snagtooth's Coins
items.description: A greasy pouch of copper pieces.

items.name: Wick's Coins
items.description: A greasy pouch of copper pieces.

rooms.name: Well Yard
rooms.description: A walled yard at the orchard's edge, its cobbles green with moss. An old well head stands in the middle under a wooden windlass.

features.name: Well Head
features.description: A ring of mossy stone over a dark shaft. Far below, something glints, and cool air rises from the vaults.

failure-by-5.text: Your hold slips on the wet stone, and you drop the last of the way into the silt.

failure.text: You scrape down the last of it and land hard, but unhurt.

success.text: You find the old footholds in the shaft and climb down.

success-by-5.text: You go down hand over hand and land without a sound.

features.name: Bucket Windlass
features.description: A wooden windlass with no rope on it. The bucket is gone.

features.name: Orchard Wall
features.description: A dry-stone wall, with apple boughs hanging over it heavy with fruit.

rooms.name: Cart Shed
rooms.description: An open-fronted shed smelling of horse and axle grease. A flat cart stands empty, waiting for barrels.

features.name: Cart
features.description: A flat river cart with high sides, its bed stained with cider.
features.discovery: The tailboard is branded with a V inside a ring: the same mark is chalked on barrels all over the farm.

features.name: Harness Pegs
features.description: Pegs hung with a carthorse's harness. The horse is nowhere to be seen.

features.name: Feed Sack
features.description: A sack of oats, slit open. Something has been eating from it.

rooms.name: Cellar Stair
rooms.description: Worn steps run down from the trapdoor into a cool, dark passage that smells of wet stone and apples. A barrel ramp runs beside them.

features.name: Worn Steps
features.description: Stone steps hollowed by three generations of Pells carrying casks.

features.name: Lamp Niche
features.description: A niche in the wall, blackened by a lamp that has gone.

features.name: Chalk Tally
features.description: Chalk marks on the wall, in rows.
features.discovery: It's a careful human hand, not a goblin's: twenty-two barrels, each marked "paid" with a V inside a ring.

rooms.name: Cask Gallery
rooms.description: A long vault cut into the hill, lined with great casks on stone cradles. The air is thick and sweet. Passages lead off in every direction, and an iron-bound door is set in the far wall.

features.name: Great Casks
features.description: Casks taller than a man, most of them tapped and dry. Chalked on nearly every one is a V inside a ring.
features.discovery: Low on one cask, half rubbed out, is a bare V with no ring: the goblins' mark. Its bung pulls out, and inside, hung on a string, is the goblins' cut of the river man's money: a bag of silver.

failure.text: Cask after cask, the same chalk mark. Nothing stands out.

success.text: You find the cask with the bare V.

features.name: Spigot Rack
features.description: A rack of brass spigots, every one of them missing but two.

items.name: Goblins' Cut
items.description: A bag of silver pieces: two for every barrel sold.

rooms.name: Well Bottom
rooms.description: A round chamber at the foot of the well shaft, damp and dripping. Daylight is a coin of white far above.

features.name: Silted Floor
features.description: Grey silt, a foot deep. Coins glint in it here and there.
features.discovery: Generations of wishes: a scatter of coins, green and worn, but still good.

features.name: Dropped Bucket
features.description: The well's bucket, split open where it fell.

features.name: Sump Arch
features.description: A low arch leading down. Black water laps beyond it, and the air is foul.

items.name: Wishing Coins
items.description: A scatter of old coins, worn smooth.

rooms.name: Pell Strongroom
rooms.description: A small, dry room behind the iron-bound door, smelling of wax and old paper. The Pells kept everything that mattered here.

features.name: Iron Chest
features.description: A squat iron chest, not locked.
features.discovery: Inside are the Pells' savings, wrapped in cloth, and a silver cup engraved with the names of babies.

features.name: Ledger Shelf
features.description: Fifty years of Bramblecote's accounts, in a row of leather ledgers.

features.name: Cider-Wife's Shrine
features.description: A little shrine of an apple-cheeked woman holding a cup, with a dried wreath of apple blossom.

items.name: Pell Christening Cup
items.description: A small silver cup, engraved with four generations of Pell children's names.

items.name: Pell Savings
items.description: A cloth bundle of gold coins.

rooms.name: Bottling Room
rooms.description: A dry side vault with a heavy door that bars from inside. Rows of empty bottles glint on racks, and a cot stands in the corner.

features.name: Corking Bench
features.description: A bench of corks, wire and wax.
features.discovery: In the bench's drawer, under the corks, is a stoppered vial of red liquid.

features.name: Bottle Racks
features.description: Racks of green glass bottles, every one empty.

features.name: Farmhand's Cot
features.description: The farmhand's cot, his blanket still folded on it.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

rooms.name: Cider Store
rooms.description: Lamplight falls over rows of full barrels, each chalked with a V inside a ring. The room smells of cider and pipe smoke.

features.name: Fence's Strongbox
features.description: A small strongbox on a barrel head, its lid open.
features.discovery: Corran's takings: a few gold coins and a banded agate he took in trade.

features.name: Rolled Barrels
features.description: Barrels lined up on their sides, ready to roll down to the river door.

features.name: Tally Slate
features.description: A slate hung on a nail.
features.discovery: "Snagtooth: 2 sp a barrel. Sells at the quay for 2 gp." The fence has done well.

items.name: Banded Agate
items.description: A brown and white striped agate.

items.name: Corran Vey's Coins
items.description: A small pouch of silver pieces.

rooms.name: Flooded Sump
rooms.description: The low cellar is knee-deep in black water that smells of river mud and rot. A rusted grating lets in the sound of the river.

features.name: Black Water
features.description: Cold, still water. You can't see the bottom.

features.name: Smuggler's Purse
features.description: A rotted leather purse caught on the grating, where the river left it.
features.discovery: In the purse is a single red-orange stone.

features.name: Rusted Grating
features.description: An iron grating over a culvert to the river, rusted solid.

items.name: Carnelian
items.description: A red-orange carnelian, smooth and cold.

rooms.name: River Door
rooms.description: The passage ends at a low door onto the riverbank. You hear the river running fast beyond it, and smell weed and wet rope.

features.name: Smugglers' Door
features.description: An old oak door, its bolts well greased. It opens onto a muddy bank and the river.

features.name: Mooring Ring
features.description: An iron ring set in the bank outside, a fresh rope burn on it.

features.name: River Steps
features.description: Stone steps down to the water, slick with weed.

passages.description: A muddy track round the back of the farmhouse. A chain rattles somewhere.
The cart track to an open shed.
A lean-to door, propped with a stave.
The press house's yard doors. Wasps drone inside.
A gap in the orchard wall.
A low door with a bar on its inner side.
The back door, across a few steps of yard to the press house.
A ladder up into the hayloft. Snoring comes down it.
The open trapdoor and its barrel ramp, down into the vaults.
The old well shaft, down into the vaults.
The passage at the foot of the steps.

door.name: Strongroom Door
door.description: A heavy oak door strapped with iron, locked fast.

failure-by-5.text: The door doesn't budge, and you jar your shoulder against the iron.

passages.description: A side door, its bar hanging loose.
An archway. Lamplight and pipe smoke drift through it.
The smugglers' passage, sloping down toward the sound of the river.
The low arch, down into black water.

opponents.name: Brack
opponents.description: A big brindled farm dog, ribs showing, hurls himself at you to the end of his chain.

opponents.name: Nib
opponents.description: A goblin sticky with mash to the elbows lurches up from the pomace heap, waving a dagger.

opponents.name: Snagtooth
opponents.description: A goblin with one long yellow tusk rolls off his sack, snatches up a scimitar and snarls.

opponents.name: Wick
opponents.description: A runty goblin with an iron key on a string round his neck scrambles up behind his chief.

surrender.description: Wick drops his dagger and curls up in the hay, clutching the key on his string.

topics.name: the key
topics.reply: "The old woman's key! Take it, take it. Wick only keeps it for the chief."

topics.name: Snagtooth
topics.reply: "The chief will be angry. He hits very hard, and he never shares."

topics.name: the river man
topics.reply: "The river man buys the barrels. He counts them in the cider store, and his big man waits with the cart."

topics.name: the water
topics.reply: "Don't go in the low cellar. Something walks in the water there. It doesn't sleep."

opponents.name: Dace
opponents.description: A thickset carter gets up from the cart's tail, a scimitar in his hand. "Corran said no visitors."

opponents.name: Corran Vey
opponents.description: A lean man in a river-boatman's coat puts down his chalk, takes the pipe from his mouth and draws a scimitar.

opponents.name: Drowned Smuggler
opponents.description: A bloated smuggler, drowned in the sump long ago, rises from the black water with weed hanging from its jaw, and wades toward you.

endings.title: Out with the Pells' goods
endings.text: You come out of Bramblecote with what you could carry. Ressa Pell counts it with shaking hands, and for the first time since the pressing, she smiles.

endings.title: Out of Bramblecote
endings.text: You leave the cider house with nothing to show for it. Ressa Pell watches you go without a word.

endings.title: Fallen at Bramblecote
endings.text: You fall among the apples and the barrels of Bramblecote. Your adventuring ends here.
